script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Calling Abraham, Isaac and Jacob the new folks in town adds that they were recent arrivals. The passage says they lived in Canaan as foreigners.

The explanation says Moses is not worried about battle and describes his trouble as opening his mouth. The text says he considers himself unskilled in speech; it does not establish those other claims.
The toast-and-helmet comparison mixes two unrelated actions, so the joke does not match the situation it is meant to illustrate.
The pocket-search and pat-down jokes apply a human action to what God might do to Pharaoh's heart. Comparisons must stay on the human side of the moment.
